messages.subject: Re: Fwd: Order L-43792 confirmed
messages.text:
Hello Nahoko,
 

 Here are the instructions for a return/exchange: 
 

 1. Go to https://lasclay.happyreturns.com/ to obtain a return label. After entering your order number and zip code, select the products you wish to return and then choose the replacements. At the end, you will receive a prepaid return label.
 

 2. Print the label, pack the products to be returned, and affix the label to the package. Please prefer the use of envelopes/bags instead of boxes, which are more expensive.
 

 3. Drop it off at a Canada Post red box or at the nearest post office.
 

 4. Once the return is received, we will send the new product(s) and request a $9.99 exchange fee (if applicable) 😊
 

 Warm regards,
 

 __
 Laurence 
 

 Lasclay
